outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: new section '# --- deciding a step on facts ---' above close_task with _fact (a fact is a value or a zero-arg callable, called only when reached; a missing fact raises KeyError), _at_point (an unknown point raises ValueError) and four planners, each planner(point, facts) -> (arm, detail): _advance_plan (points writer, scope, reviewer, gate, risk, close), _triage_plan (advance, tail), _pending_turn (stale, route), _close_plan (findings, lock, route, commit, answer); _writer_facts/_reviewer_facts build the advance points' facts. advance(), close_task(), triage() and drive_locked() now read their facts and perform the arm; no function renamed or removed. Lazy reads kept: note_sessions stays first and unconditional in advance and between the stale and route points in drive_locked; stored_green in the gate point is a callable read first, unconditionally, as before; the one in the file-return arm is unchanged inline; standing_use (writes a journal row) is a callable read only when neither confirmed nor answered in advance; confirmed_in_advance only for an unconfirmed high-risk task; review_rounds (writes state) is a callable at the triage tail point, asked only after the advance point, with the not-applied did-line appended before it as before; rounds_cost_lines stays in the round-cap arm; own_commit is read only when the step named no sha; writer_holds only when no executor return is filed; pending_still_applies only when a decision waits; advance_admissible only after the other conjuncts; gate_went_red only for a phase-key fix task; filed(reviewer) stays under `if due`. One reorder: verdict_moved is now read before the stale decision's state.pop/write_state instead of after; it reads only ctx['basisNoted']/ctx['basisMoved'] and write_state writes only the state file, so neither sees the other. tests/test_drive_phase.py: up-block (up1-up26), ut-block (ut1-ut8), uq-block (uq1-uq14), uc-block (ucl1-ucl9; uc1-uc8 were taken by an existing block) added to STAGES; each case asserts an arm and a one-fact-flipped twin with literal expected values, fake facts, no repository; facts an arm must not read raise via _never. The test variables avoid names the file-wide git-argv scanner (bare_git_calls) already binds, since an earlier spelling cascaded that set and flagged line 8928. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: one paragraph in the drive-phase.py section naming the planners and why there is no single decide(). Tallies: drive suite before 688 cases exit 0 (HEAD 9f714cb5), after 745 cases exit 0; new blocks 57/57; test__deps 254 cases exit 0; test__output_lints 173 cases exit 0; ruff and vermin -t=3.8- clean on both .py files; test__help 79/79 and test__affected_tests 35/35 run directly as dependants of the guide.
